newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one stories.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one stories.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Thursday:

WASHINGTON - A Justice Department investigation into improper political fund-raising activities has uncovered evidence that representatives of the People's Republic of China sought to direct contributions from foreign sources to the Democratic National Committee before the 1996 presidentail campaign.

WASHINGTON - The Clinton administration hopes to make prime time television a major battlefield in the war on drugs with a $350 million media campaign designed to counter rapidly increasing teenage drug abuse.
WASHINGTON - The House defeated a constitutional amendment that would have limited the time lawmakers may serve in the House and Senate.
WASHINGTON - The surging stock market reached a new high as a rally in technology stocks spread to other sectors and the public continued to pour money into mutual funds.
WASHINGTON - North Korea's Stalinist regime suffered the highest level defection in its history when its top theoretician sought asylum in the South Korean embassy in Beijing.
WASHINGTON - Talking on a cellular phone while driving may quadruple a person's risk of having a serious auto accident, a new study has found.
WASHINGTON - The holder of U.S. rights to the French abortion pill said that it has settled a lawsuit and as a result will be able to bring the drug to the U.S. market by the end of this year.
